feeds.title: Keep Indiana Learning Blog
feeds.description: Keep Indiana Learning, a department of the Central Indiana Educational Service Center (CIESC), provides educators with an empowering and collaborative network to provide relevant, engaging, and equitable learning opportunities for all students. The Digital Learning Coaches of KIL are a cohort of exceptional learning specialists throughout the state of Indiana, creating content to support teachers, leaders, and students. If you're looking for coaching or creation support, feel free to reach out directly to one of these selected coaches for guidance.

feeds.title: Indiana Coalition for Public Education Blog
feeds.description: Indiana Coalition for Public Education's mission is to be a strong, convening voice for public education advocacy in Indiana. Their bipartisan board reflects ICPE's commitment to supporting public education in Indiana. They blog about everything related to public education and anything that affects it. Keep up to date by reading new articles on education here on Indiana Coalition for Public Education Blog.

feeds.title: Indiana Online
feeds.description: Indiana Online, a department of CIESC, is an accredited online education platform that provides innovative courses while promoting the advancement of learning throughout the state of Indiana. The high-tech environment provides frequent, personalized contact between a highly qualified, licensed teacher and each student. The course offers academic challenges for each student using a variety of teaching strategies to motivate each student to successfully master standards. Browse content for useful information about our classes, programs, and more.

feeds.title: School Matters
feeds.description: K-12 education system in America, Indiana, and Monroe County. School Matters is a blog about news articles on everything and anything related to children's education in Indiana. The blog's sole purpose is for everyone to educate themselves on the education system. They even contain news about politics, local, and cultural, articles, and how it affects education in Indiana.

feeds.title: Education Week » Indiana
feeds.description: Since 1981, Education Week has been America's most trusted resource for K-12 education news and information. A diverse audience turns to us for the most up-to-date information on K-12 education in the U.S. and innovative, high-value tools and solutions. It is our mission to empower the entire education community, from educators and policymakers to business leaders and beyond. The latest education policy news and instruction trends from Indiana, including articles, opinion essays, data, and videos are shared on our blog.

feeds.title: The Times of Northwest Indiana » Local Education
feeds.description: The Times of Northwest Indiana - the source for crime, business, government, education, and sports news and information in the region. More than 50,000+ articles can be found on local education itself. Apart from that Time includes inspired living, get healthy and in business magazines, and a monthly your family special section.

feeds.title: IAACE Blog
feeds.description: The IAACE's purpose is to advocate for adult education in Indiana. We cultivate leaders who advance adult education for stronger communities in Indiana.

feeds.title: The IAHE Blog
feeds.description: The IAHE is a not-for-profit organization founded in 1983 that supports and encourages families interested in home education. We define home education as parent-directed, home-based, privately-funded education. Our primary functions are maintaining visibility as home educators with civil government leaders, influencing the legislative process to protect our freedom to home educate, publishing information of interest for home educators, and sponsoring seminars and events to encourage families.

feeds.title: Central Indiana Educational Service Center Blog
feeds.description: Central Indiana Educational Service Center is a non-profit providing free and at-cost educational programs throughout central Indiana and beyond. CIESC is committed to innovative programs and exceptional service enhancing academic achievement and operational efficiencies. They have a dedicated blog which updates news articles or announcements on CIESC.

feeds.title: Education Support Hub Blog
feeds.description: The Education Support Hub is a timely, in-depth, supplementary resource for professionals, parents, students, and members of the Muncie community. They are an online resource that provides information and resources to help students achieve academic success. Their website focuses on finding summer camps and after-school programs to combat learning loss. Some in-depth insights are shared on Summer Learning. They even write about Classroom support, educational support, health, medical, housing, finance, and much more.

feeds.title: Chalkbeat Indiana
feeds.description: Chalkbeat is a nonprofit news organization committed to covering one of America's most important stories: the effort to improve schools for all children, especially those who have historically lacked access to quality education. We are mission-driven, in that we believe that every child deserves an excellent education and that a strong press is vital to making that happen. Chalkbeat Network is a local news website covering schools and school policy in Indianapolis.

feeds.title: Teach Indy Blog
feeds.description: Teach Indy is a partnership among Indianapolis Public Schools (IPS), the Office of Education Innovation, and The Mind Trust designed to bring more outstanding teachers to Indianapolis. Discover what it's like to work in a city full of opportunity where we're changing education for good.

feeds.title: Learn More Indiana
feeds.description: Learn More Indiana (LMI) helps Hoosier of all ages explore post-high school education options and the ways to pay for it. Led by the Indiana Commission for Higher Education, LMI provides resources, tools and real-life guidance for Hoosier students, families and educators to make the process of accessing post-high school education manageable and attainable.
